actual_Boolean_family: All pairs of nonconstant labelled two-bit indicators; triples with two nonconstant two-bit indicators and a nonconstant one-bit indicator; all four-fold products of nonconstant one-bit indicators. Separate physical-overlap fixture U=V=OR2.
parameter_domain: 14^2 pairs, 14^2*2 triples, 2^4 four-fold products; two fixed local reference styles (uniform nonempty and weights proportional to mask+1); no adaptive enlargement
case_count: Full: 392 pair-reference cases + 784 triple-reference cases + 32 four-factor-reference cases = 1208. Pilot: first two labelled indicators in each component, same dimensions, 64 cases. Three rational marked-tree root fixtures at four heights; PGF rational tail certificate; overlap fixture.
symmetry: None; labelled indicators retained. Parenthesizations are regroupings of the same fixed product and reference, not new Boolean cases.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms; fractions; exact rational prime-exponent vectors for logarithms. No floating-point sign acceptance.
acceptance: Exact reference normalization, physical pivotal influence, signed activation-cost identity, augmented-cost telescope, equality of flat and nested output distributions, source statement hashes, PGF and root moment signs; exact physical-overlap alias mismatch.
